children: Balfour Beatty's trading update is bullish and shows strong momentum, Jefferies analysts write. The U.K. infrastructure group upgrades its guidance, which translates to underlying earnings growth of around 5% for 2026, and between 7% and 9% in 2027, based on Jefferies forecasts. Balfour Beatty should carry strong momentum into 2027, the analysts say, with potential for midteens earnings growth. This will benefit from strong demand in the U.K. and U.S., with further margin improvement expected, Jefferies adds. The valuation of the stock remains attractive, the analysts say. Shares are up 4.4%. (michael.hennessey@wsj.com)
